what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Russia in Israel: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3577 Russian asylum seekers in Israel, 4.1% of all asylum seekers from Russia.
Refugees from Russia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Russia in 2023 and 2024, with LSR, RDK and Wagner as opponents.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5932, at the end of 2019; the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2020 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Israel.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Israel only.
